items.title: 9.1 Introduction to Design Thinking and Business Solutions (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Yeh chapter entrepreneurship (karobar ki shuruaat aur chalana) ka taaruf karata hai: karobari kamyabi ki maharatein aur hikmat-e-amli, jiddat, takhleeqi salahiyat aur masail hal karne samait. Yeh design thinking ko hal banane ka insan markooz tareeqa batata, aur business plan banane, market insights jama karne aur idea pitch karne ke saath marketing aur sales, maali tasawwurat, baat cheet, tawun aur iteration sikhata hai.
Design thinking aur doosre takhleeqi tareeqe karobaron ko challenges ka saamna karne aur gahakon ki zarooratein behtar poori karne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Entrepreneurship ki apne alfaaz mein tareef kijiye (short question 1). Is ka bunyadi maqsad kya hai (MCQ 1)?
blocks.explanation: Entrepreneurship kisi masle ya mauqe ko pehchan kar, kuch khatra qabool kar ke, aisa karobar shuru karna hai jo use is tarah hal kare ke log qeemat ada karein. (b) masail hal karna aur qadr paida karna. Chapter lafz ki seedhi tareef nahi deta; yeh tareef aam ilm hai.

items: Entrepreneurship: naye karobar se masail hal karna aur qadr paida karna.
